chatgpt_web.title: ChatGPT Web management
chatgpt_web.description: Configure automatic relogin and Web image compatibility here; run account logins on the dedicated task page and manage Sentinel SDK settings and status below.
chatgpt_web.auto_relogin_description: Automatically attempt login when a token cannot be refreshed and the credential can be relogged. Dead accounts and interaction-required states are never retried automatically.
chatgpt_web.auto_relogin_capacity_description: Separately bounds automatic relogin workers and their queue, plus management-triggered manual relogin concurrency. All three are hot-updatable; shrinking never cancels an active login.
chatgpt_web.auto_relogin_workers_description: Background login attempts allowed concurrently, from 1 to 256; default 4.
chatgpt_web.auto_relogin_queue_size_description: Maximum queued and running credential generations, from 1 to 1000000. A full queue keeps credentials isolated and records backpressure.
chatgpt_web.manual_relogin_concurrency_description: Concurrent management-triggered synchronous and asynchronous manual relogins; default 4 and recommended 1–512, while larger positive integers are accepted. At capacity, requests fail fast with 429 instead of waiting server-side. This does not limit automatic relogin workers.
chatgpt_web.api798_auto_login: Allow API798 fallback in Auto mode
chatgpt_web.api798_auto_login_description: When enabled, Auto may use a saved API798 URL only if the credential has neither Passkey nor password material. Explicit API798 selection works regardless of this switch; Passkey failures never silently fall back.
chatgpt_web.session_cookie_refresh_on_token_failure: Use Session Cookie when Access Token fails
chatgpt_web.session_cookie_refresh_on_token_failure_: For credentials without complete password and 2FA material, use a complete ChatGPT Session Cookie to refresh an expired or rejected Access Token. Only definitive Session expiry marks the credential dead; network, Cloudflare, rate-limit, malformed-response, and incomplete-cookie failures do not.
chatgpt_web.force_session_refresh_on_import_descript: When enabled, queue a background Session refresh even if the imported Access Token is still valid. Upload no longer waits for this request. When disabled, a refresh is queued only if the Token is missing or expired.
chatgpt_web.auto_delete_dead_auths_description: Use the staggered background maintenance queue only after ChatGPT Web confirms that the account lifecycle is dead. Cooling, exhausted image quota, and interaction-required accounts are not deleted.
chatgpt_web.invalid_passkey_response_as_dead_descrip: When enabled, classify a credential as dead only after every fresh-challenge Passkey attempt returns invalid_passkey_response, its Access Token is definitively invalid, all other recovery paths are unavailable, and no password or TOTP material remains. Network, Cloudflare, rate-limit, 5xx, or ambiguous protocol errors never trigger deletion.
chatgpt_web.auto_delete_dead_runtime_count: Automatically deleted during this server run
chatgpt_web.auto_delete_dead_priorities_description: Delete dead credentials only when their integer priority exactly matches this list. Leave empty to match every priority.
chatgpt_web.image_upstream_model_description: Upstream model used for ChatGPT Web picture_v2 conversations. The backend uses gpt-5-5 when empty.
chatgpt_web.ignore_unsupported_image_params_descript: When enabled, image options that ChatGPT Web cannot handle no longer exclude Web routing. Compatible JPEG and WebP output can be encoded locally. Remote images, file_id, invalid masks, and resource limits are still rejected.
chatgpt_web.image_size_title: Image aspect ratio and output size
chatgpt_web.image_size_description: Optionally turn any compliant explicit WxH into an exact aspect-ratio instruction and resize the final image without changing upstream Usage. Each edge must be a positive multiple of 16, the ratio must be 1:3–3:1, and total pixels must be 655,360–8,294,400.
chatgpt_web.adapt_size_to_aspect_ratio: Adapt size to a Web aspect ratio
chatgpt_web.adapt_size_to_aspect_ratio_description: For any compliant explicit WxH, append its exact reduced aspect ratio as an internal ChatGPT Web instruction. Empty and auto sizes remain untouched.
chatgpt_web.strict_size_description: Exclude ChatGPT Web when an explicit size violates the native multiple-of-16, 1:3–3:1 ratio, edge, or pixel-count constraints. Compatible Codex or native credentials remain eligible; return a size error only when none are available.
chatgpt_web.aspect_ratio_max_error_percent_descripti: Accept the generated image only when its ratio differs from the requested ratio by no more than this value (0–10%).
chatgpt_web.resize_to_requested_size_description: When the generated ratio is accepted, center-crop minimally and resize to the exact requested WxH.
chatgpt_web.resize_filter_description: Choose high-quality Catmull-Rom or faster ApproxBiLinear processing.
chatgpt_web.max_resize_edge_pixels_description: Maximum requested edge for local aspect-ratio adaptation and resizing. The configurable and hard maximum is 3840 pixels.
chatgpt_web.max_image_response_megabytes_description: Maximum total compressed image bytes returned by one request, from 1 to 256 MiB.
chatgpt_web.max_n_description: Maximum images allowed in one ChatGPT Web call, from 1 to 10. This also limits aggregation memory and image quota consumption.
chatgpt_web.image_capacity_description: Bound complete ChatGPT Web image lifecycles before upstream work, stage settled results, and set the shared image working-set budget.
chatgpt_web.image_max_in_flight: Maximum Web image tasks in flight
chatgpt_web.image_max_in_flight_description: Complete Web image tasks allowed at once, including tasks sleeping between polls. Recommended range: 1–4096.
chatgpt_web.image_poll_concurrency_description: Actual poll HTTP requests allowed at once. Sleeping between polls does not hold a slot. Recommended range: 1–512.
chatgpt_web.image_admission_queue_size_description: Requests allowed to wait before their first upstream call. Excess requests fail fast. Recommended range: 0–4096.
chatgpt_web.image_admission_wait_milliseconds_descri: Maximum bounded wait before upstream work starts; 0 disables waiting. Recommended range: 0–30000 ms.
chatgpt_web.image_max_finalizers_description: Settled tasks allowed into finalizer staging, independently of memory-heavy finalizer concurrency. Recommended range: 1–64.
chatgpt_web.image_memory_finalizer_concurrency_descr: Tasks allowed to perform bounded disk spooling and memory-heavy completion concurrently. Each task spools compressed results first, then obtains one complete working-set grant before decode, resize, encode, and response assembly. Effective concurrency is the minimum of maximum finalizer staging, this value, and the complete working sets that fit the shared memory budget. Recommended range: 1–64.
chatgpt_web.image_completion_reserve_megabytes_descr: Memory allowance reserved for each admitted task before upstream generation starts. Recommended range: 0–32 MiB.
chatgpt_web.image_memory_capacity_megabytes_descript: Process-wide working-set budget shared by all ChatGPT Web image requests. It is neither a per-request limit nor the entire Go heap. Recommended range: 64–8192 MiB.

request_body_release.title: Request Body Residency Release
request_body_release.description: enable=false disables request body release. enable=true with log-only=true releases only request log, upstream log, and WebSocket timeline body copies after the timer fires or a streaming upstream is successfully established; it does not affect real request forwarding and does not block credential switching, model fallback, or request-retry. enable=true with log-only=false performs real request body release after the timer fires or a streaming upstream is successfully established; it does not interrupt the already-sent upstream request, but after release it stops credential switching, model fallback, stream bootstrap retry, and request-retry. Logs use placeholder text instead of the original request body.
request_body_release.enable_desc: Release local request body references after the time threshold. Disabled by default.
request_body_release.log_only_desc: When enabled, this is lightweight log-copy release. Real release only happens when enable is on and log-only is off.
request_body_release.thresholds_hint: after-seconds is the timed release threshold. Streaming requests may release earlier after a successful upstream stream is established. Recommended example: log-only=true, after-seconds=30, min-body-bytes=1048576.
request_body_release.after_seconds_hint: 0 or empty only disables timed release. Release after a successful streaming upstream is still controlled by enable/log-only.
request_body_release.min_body_bytes_hint: 0 or empty means no size limit.

request_body_audit.keywords_hint: Add text keywords one by one. Empty strings are ignored when saving.
request_body_audit.keywords_base64_hint: Advanced text list: enter one Base64-encoded raw byte keyword per row.

auth.title: Authentication Configuration
auth.description: API keys and authentication directory settings
auth.auth_model_exclusions_desc: Exclude registered models by provider, model, priority, and non-sensitive identity keywords, or disable Codex image generation for matching credentials.
auth.auth_model_exclusions_hint: Multiple providers use OR; providers, priorities, and keyword-contains matchers use AND between categories. Matching credentials do not register the listed models. Disabling image generation still applies only to Codex. Keywords only match non-sensitive identity fields such as file name, email, label, account, provider, and plan_type.
auth.auth_model_exclusions_models_hint: Required unless image generation is disabled. Supports multiple ordered models. Normal mode excludes listed models. When the first item is -all, all models are excluded first and later +model IDs are kept.
auth.auth_model_exclusions_models_hint_disabl: Optional. Leave empty to only disable Codex image generation for matching credentials without excluding registered models.
auth.auth_model_exclusions_models_all_mode_hi: All models are excluded first; models starting with + are kept
auth.auth_model_exclusions_disable_image_gene: Matching Codex credentials will not use image_generation. Leave models empty to only disable images.
auth.auth_model_exclusions_providers_hint: Optional. Multiple providers use OR. Leave empty to match any provider. Custom runtime provider IDs are supported.
auth.auth_model_exclusions_priorities_hint: Optional. For example: -1. Fill at least one provider, priority, or keyword matcher.
auth.auth_model_exclusions_keyword_contains_h: Optional. Matches non-sensitive credential identity fields case-insensitively.
auth.disabled_image_tool_policy_desc: When a credential matches an image-disabled rule but a normal text request still carries an image_generation tool, this global policy controls how it is handled.
auth.disabled_image_tool_fallback_desc: When enabled, normal text requests carrying image_generation tool will first be routed to a Codex credential at the same or lower priority that still supports image generation if the current credential matches an image-disabled rule. If none is available, the fallback action below applies.
auth.disabled_image_tool_action_hint: When no image-capable credential is available, remove strips the image_generation tool and continues the request; error returns the configured error directly.

system.title: System Configuration
system.description: Debug, logging, statistics, and performance settings
system.commercial_mode_desc: Disable high-overhead middleware to support high concurrency
system.logs_retention_days_desc: Remove logs by age first, then by total size. 0 disables age-based cleanup.
system.usage_statistics_persist_desc: 0 or empty restores at startup and saves on graceful shutdown, without periodic snapshots.
system.usage_statistics_persistence_desc: Controls Usage snapshot restore and writes independently. In-memory collection for this run can remain enabled.
system.usage_statistics_retention_days_desc: Remove older request details before saving. 0 disables age-based cleanup.
system.usage_statistics_max_storage_desc: Limit the serialized snapshot file on disk by trimming old details before saving. This is not a Go heap limit; decoded objects, strings, and indexes can use several times more memory. 0 disables size-based cleanup.
system.pprof_enable_desc: Expose management-authenticated /v0/management/pprof/* sampling endpoints when enabled
system.pprof_addr_desc: Only affects the optional standalone pprof server. Keep it bound to 127.0.0.1.

network.title: Network Configuration
network.proxy_check_mode_inherit: No global proxy is set. The default network behavior is used.
network.request_retry_hint: attempt 0 is the initial round. Set 2 to allow attempt 1 and attempt 2 after failure while stepping down credential priority per round.
network.max_retry_credentials_hint: Non-negative integer. 0 = all available credentials at the current priority; a positive value limits different credentials per round.
network.max_retry_interval_hint: When every credential at the target priority is cooling, wait at most this many seconds for the nearest recovery. This does not decide whether another round is allowed.
network.routing_fill_first_range_hint: Group every N accounts, fill between groups, and randomize within each group to improve fill-first concurrency. 1 keeps the original fill-first behavior.
network.routing_fill_first_per_auth_rpm_hint: Use the next credential only after the first one reaches this minute's limit. At the next minute, earlier credentials are preferred again. 0 disables it, and it cannot be enabled with a fill range greater than 1.
network.routing_per_auth_request_limit_hint: Applies to random, round-robin, and fill-first strategies. 0 disables it. Requests are counted in the fixed window below.
network.routing_per_auth_request_window_minutes_: Fixed window length, with a minimum of 1 minute. This value is retained even when the request limit is 0.
network.routing_generic_limit_precedence: The new generic limit takes precedence; the legacy fill-first-per-auth-rpm value is retained.
network.priority_overrides_desc: Override the global routing strategy, per-round credential limit, and per-credential request limit by credential priority.
network.priority_overrides_hint: priority may be negative and must be unique. Empty values inherit global settings. The generic request limit applies to every strategy; fill-first-range and fill-first-per-auth-rpm apply only to fill-first and cannot both be enabled.
network.priority_overrides_fill_first_range_hint: Group every N accounts, fill between groups, and randomize within each group. Leave empty to inherit the global fill range.
network.priority_overrides_fill_first_per_auth_r: Use the next credential only after the first one reaches this minute's limit. Leave empty to inherit the global value; 0 disables it.
network.priority_overrides_per_auth_request_limi: Applies to random, round-robin, and fill-first. Leave empty to inherit globally; 0 explicitly disables the generic limit for this priority.
network.priority_overrides_per_auth_request_wind: Leave empty to inherit globally. When set, the minimum is 1 minute.
network.priority_subscription_overrides_hint: Within this priority, override per-credential request limits by plan type and optional provider. Unmatched credentials inherit this priority.
network.priority_subscription_overrides_plan_typ: Multiple values use OR, such as pro, plus, and team. ChatGPT*Plan values are normalized automatically.
Add at least one plan type
The backend normalizes aliases such as ChatGPT*Plan to these values. Custom types not listed here can still be added in the input.
network.priority_subscription_overrides_provider: Leave empty for all providers. Otherwise use exact provider IDs such as codex or chatgpt-web.
These options use exact runtime provider IDs. Leave empty for all providers; custom IDs not listed here can still be added in the input.
network.priority_subscription_overrides_limit_hi: Leave empty to inherit this priority. 0 explicitly disables the generic limit for this subscription.
network.priority_subscription_overrides_window_h: Leave empty to inherit this priority. When set, the minimum is 1 minute. Set at least a limit or a window.
network.non_retryable_errors_desc: Matching errors are returned to the client directly without switching credentials or entering request-retry
network.non_retryable_errors_hint: Existing built-in rules such as invalid_request_error / 422 remain active. Leave status-code empty or set 0 to match any status.
network.non_retryable_errors_status_code_hint: Empty or 0 means any status. When filled, it must be 100-599.
network.non_retryable_errors_message_hint: Case-insensitive contains match. Fill at least one of status code, type, code, or message.
network.error_response_rewrites_desc: Match final errors, including local conversion and cache failures, and rewrite the status code or JSON body returned to the client
network.error_response_rewrites_hint: The first matching rule wins. Fill at least one matcher and one response change.
network.error_response_rewrites_status_code_hint: Empty or 0 matches any status. When set, it must be 100-599.
network.error_response_rewrites_message_hint: Case-insensitive contains match. Fill at least a status code or error message.
network.error_response_rewrites_response_status_: Empty or 0 preserves the original status. When set, it must be 400-599.
network.error_response_rewrites_response_body_to: Off omits response-body and preserves the original body. On submits the JSON object below.
network.error_response_rewrites_response_body_hi: Must be a JSON object. {} explicitly returns an empty JSON object.
network.error_response_rewrites_streaming_notice: After the first streaming bytes are sent, only the terminal error event can be rewritten; the HTTP status remains 200.
network.error_response_rewrites_trust_sse_notice: With trust-upstream-sse enabled, regular frames still pass through unchanged, while terminal error rewrites remain active.
network.force_model_prefix_desc: Unprefixed model requests only use credentials without prefix
network.session_affinity_failover_desc: Allow a bound session to move to another credential when the bound credential is unavailable or a request fails. Disable for strict sticky sessions.
network.codex_identity_confuse_desc: Stably remap Codex session, window, and turn identities per account before upstream requests, then restore original IDs in responses.
network.codex_spoof_session_identity_desc: Fill missing Session, Thread, Window, and Turn identities for Codex OAuth and Agent Identity requests. Explicit client values are preserved.
network.codex_turn_state_policy_passthrough_desc: Forward every client X-Codex-Turn-State unchanged without checking account ownership. Cross-account reuse may trigger risk controls.
network.codex_turn_state_policy_guard_cross_acco: Drop states known to belong to another account while retaining same-account and unknown states. This is the default compatibility mode.
network.codex_turn_state_policy_same_account_onl: Forward only states registered to the current account. After restart, expiry, or capacity eviction, old states are dropped because ownership is unknown.
network.codex_turn_state_policy_strip_desc: Remove every outbound turn state. New states from upstream responses are still recorded and returned to the client.
network.codex_fingerprint_default_mode: Default fingerprint mode for future uploads
network.codex_fingerprint_default_mode_desc: Write this mode only to future Codex OAuth/file credential uploads that omit codex_fingerprint_mode. Existing credentials and explicit upload values are unchanged.
network.codex_fingerprint_session_identity_pool_: Range: 1–64. A value of 1 keeps one converged identity; larger values select a sticky slot by tenant, account, and session key. Resizing recalculates slot assignment, while every logical request still gets its own Turn ID.
network.codex_fingerprint_ja3_desc: Force Codex upstream requests to use the native Codex TLS 1.2 ClientHello, HTTP/1.1, and Codex request header order. Disabled by default.
network.codex_fingerprint_force_http1_desc: Force all Codex HTTPS upstream requests to use HTTP/1.1. Disabled by default.
network.codex_fingerprint_images_force_http1_des: Only force image_generation requests to use HTTP/1.1. Can be enabled together with the global HTTP/1.1 switch.
network.codex_enforce_software_identity_desc: Enabled by default. Normalize User-Agent, Originator, and Version for outbound Codex OAuth/file requests. Client values cannot change the final tuple; Codex API keys are unaffected.
network.codex_header_defaults_user_agent_hint: Minimum compatible version: 0.144.0. Older versions are upgraded only in outbound requests without changing the saved value. Unparseable values fall back to the built-in Codex User-Agent.

images.title: OpenAI Images Compatibility
images.description: Proxy OpenAI Images API through the Codex Responses image_generation tool
images.native_description: Forward through Codex native Images API support. Applies only to native Images API paths and does not add an extra upload flow.
images.native_enabled_desc: When enabled, matching models use the Codex native Images API path.
images.native_models_hint: Add the models supported by native Images. Leave empty to let the backend use its default model list.
images.native_param_rules_hint: String array for native Images API paths only. n deletes a parameter, n=1 overrides a parameter, and background=transparent overrides a string.
images.native_unsupported_model_status_code_hin: HTTP status code returned when the requested model does not match models. Range: 400-599.
images.native_unsupported_model_message_hint: May include the {model} placeholder. Leave empty to let the backend use the default message.
images.stream_flush_settings_desc: Flush batching thresholds for image streaming responses. Always available regardless of native Images settings.
images.legacy_responses_tool_settings_desc: Legacy compatibility path for proxying OpenAI Images through the Codex Responses image_generation tool.
images.codex_model_hint: Responses model used to invoke the image_generation tool, defaults to gpt-5.4
images.image_model_hint: image_generation tool model exposed through /v1/images/*, defaults to gpt-image-2
images.enable_free_plan_image_model_desc: Disabled by default. When enabled, free-plan Codex credentials can also expose and use the image model.
images.enable_n_aggregation_desc: Disabled by default. When enabled, n > 1 is split into multiple Codex image calls and aggregated; when disabled, n > 1 returns an unsupported option error
images.enable_stream_flush_desc: Enabled by default. Disable it to flush every image stream chunk immediately.
images.override_response_format_url_desc: Disabled by default. When enabled, response_format=url is coerced to b64_json
images.response_format_url_data_url: Return Data URL for URL Format
images.response_format_url_data_url_desc: Disabled by default. When enabled, response_format=url wraps image base64 as data:<mime>;base64,... and returns it in the url field
images.override_transparent_background_desc: Disabled by default, background=transparent is forwarded to Codex unchanged. When enabled, it is coerced to auto
images.override_input_fidelity_desc: Disabled by default. When enabled, image requests omit input_fidelity to avoid invalid_input_fidelity_model from gpt-image-2
